rule: temporal_lane_bias_init[lane] = gate-weighted mean sum(g*e)/sum(g) of the pre-gate temporal emission e of the init checkpoint (run init transforms applied) over learned on-road HDV rows of free rollouts, by step-start lane (preserves the mean gated contribution)
notes: init checkpoint = round-9 final (round 12 init) + round 12 init transforms (centre, residual reinit, zero courtesy head) via the trainer init_from path
windows: local val-role episodes of the r9 TRAIN pool windowed as train (--all-roles-as-train); 3 batches x 2 windows x 60 s free rollouts; re-measure on TRAIN-split windows at launch
the constant keeps the per-lane mean GATED contribution; the k-profile of the emission (unweighted pre-gate mean differs: [1.722, -0.788, -1.862]) is not kept
merge_core TF term off, driver prior off, brake_follow_cav_weight 2.0 (gate overrides) for the measurement; no backward
